'''Brad Gorder''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd (?) at [[February 2001 St. Cloud tournament]] on 24 February 2001, according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1798">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01d1798/ jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 26 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-jeeps-st-cloud-report-2-24-01d1798/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
